scheme_name: GVFL – Gujarat Venture Finance Ltd Fund
overview: GVFL – Gujarat Venture Finance Ltd Fund is a venture capital firm established in 1990 that provides financial and managerial support to innovative startups across various sectors in India. It manages multiple funds tailored to different startup growth stages, including pre-seed, seed, Series A, and Series B investments. GVFL focuses on sectors such as biotechnology, deep tech, clean tech, defence tech, healthcare, consumer brands, gaming, fintech, and agri-tech, offering capital along with strategic guidance and network access.
objectives: To deliver high returns to investors while supporting innovative entrepreneurs
To promote entrepreneurship and venture capital activity in India
To provide financial and managerial support to high-growth companies
To nurture innovation across sectors including biotech, deep tech, and clean tech
To build scalable and sustainable businesses through strategic guidance and network access
eligibility: Startups operating in sectors such as biotechnology, deep tech, enterprise tech, clean tech, defence tech, healthcare & med-tech, consumer brands, gaming & entertainment, fintech, and agri-tech are eligible for GVFL's investment funds. Specific eligibility varies by fund, with focus on pre-seed, seed, Series A, and Series B stages.
benefits: GVFL provides financial backing, strategic guidance, industry connections, operational support, and fundraising assistance to portfolio companies. It leverages decades of experience, extensive networks, and valuable insights to help founders build scalable and sustainable businesses.
financial_support: GVFL offers three funds: GVFL Emerging Enterprise Venture Fund (ticket size ₹5 Cr to ₹20 Cr, with follow-on possibility), GVFL Prarambh Fund (ticket size ₹50 Lakhs to ₹3 Crore), and iCreate Angel Fund (ticket size ₹25 Lakhs to ₹1.5 Cr, focused on Gujarat-based startups). Investment instruments include CCPS and Equity across pre-seed, seed, pre-Series A, Series A, and Series B stages.
application_process: 1. Visit the GVFL pitch page at https://gvfl.com/pitch 2. Select the appropriate fund based on startup stage and geography (Emerging Enterprise Accelerator, Prarambh, or iCreate Angel) 3. Click 'Apply Now' for the chosen fund 4. Submit pitch and required details for evaluation 5. Await review and potential investment decision from GVFL team.
caveats: iCreate Angel Fund is focused exclusively on startups based out of Gujarat
Investment is subject to due diligence and GVFL's internal investment committee approval
Funds are private venture capital instruments, not government grants or subsidies
